EvaluationRuleIn.description: S3-A structured evaluation rule (validated against the answer type, governed operators, units and facts).
EvaluationRuleIn.title: EvaluationRuleIn

IntakeCallbackRequest.description: The verification obligation as the source requested it: due date and priority are source-provided.
IntakeCallbackRequest.title: IntakeCallbackRequest

IntakeParty.description:
Either an existing synthetic party (``party_ref``) or a new one (``kind`` + ``name``). Parties are never
matched on name or contact value.
IntakeParty.title: IntakeParty

IntakeReference.description: Values the intake API accepts, read from the same sources the validator uses (no new rules).
IntakeReference.title: IntakeReference

IntakeSourceRisk.description: SBQ callback-selection risk exactly as the source assigned it. Call360 calculates no band or score.
IntakeSourceRisk.title: IntakeSourceRisk

OneTimePassword.description: Returned once to the administrator; never stored in plain text, logged or audited.
OneTimePassword.title: OneTimePassword

RecordingNotice.description: S1-C test-only recording notice (D-45). Not approved AIA/MAS consent wording.
RecordingNotice.title: RecordingNotice

RecordingTimeline.description:
Recording time ↔ playback mapping for both tracks (samples at ``sample_rate``). The evidence WAV holds stored
chunks only; gaps are timeline spans, never filled audio.
RecordingTimeline.title: RecordingTimeline

RecordingTrack.description: One recorded track's manifest metadata (EVD-003). Never an object key or storage path.
RecordingTrack.title: RecordingTrack

ReviewEvidence.description: What the finding points at, as recorded. Absent media is stated, never implied.
ReviewEvidence.title: ReviewEvidence

SessionMedia.description:
API-046 from S1-C: the session's recording evidence. ``availability`` is the derived evidence vocabulary
(EXT-002): AVAILABLE (audio stored and you may retrieve it), RESTRICTED (stored, but your role lacks
``recording.read``), NOT_AVAILABLE (not recorded, purged or no capture), FAILED (consent granted, nothing
stored).
SessionMedia.title: SessionMedia

SessionTranscript.description:
API-045 from S1-D: transcript status, provenance and counts (no text) for any reader of the case. ``status``
maps to the approved ``conversation_session.transcript_status``: PENDING/PROCESSING → PENDING, COMPLETE →
FINALIZED (QUALITY_FLAGGED when uncertain speech is present), PARTIAL → PARTIAL, FAILED/UNAVAILABLE →
UNAVAILABLE. COMPLETE means every stored track was processed over complete recording coverage; it never means
correct, reviewed or certified (``review_status`` is always NOT_REVIEWED in S1).
SessionTranscript.title: SessionTranscript

condition.description: A condition version document, or at least {ast, params, inputs}.

policy.description: A policy that is not proposed yet, to try out.

fingerprint.description: The same policy revision and the same facts always give the same fingerprint.

obligations.description: Every obligation of the policy: APPLICABLE (required), NOT_APPLICABLE or UNKNOWN, with the facts read and the facts missing.

applicability.description: None: declared for every journey of the market. Otherwise a published condition, its parameters and its fingerprint.
applicability.title: Applicability

completeness.description: DECLARED_COMPLETE: its governors state that, within its scope, its controls are the complete list to assess. Coverage can be asserted only then.

scope.description: None: every application of the market. Otherwise a published condition on application facts.

combinations.description: The evidence combinations a mapping may declare. Nothing else has an approved meaning.

decisions.description: Each boundary between surveys: the ending, PROCEED or STOP, and the rule applied.

replay_sha256.description: Fingerprint of the coordinated result: the same composite and the same inputs always give the same one.
replay_sha256.title: Replay Sha256

status.description: RUNNING: the current survey waits for an answer. POLICY_UNRESOLVED: a non-answer in the current survey. CROSS_SURVEY_POLICY_UNRESOLVED: a survey ended without COMPLETED and what follows is undecided. ALL_SURVEYS_COMPLETED: progress only — not a business outcome. REPLAY_DRIFT: an individual simulation no longer recomputes to its record.

stop.description: Why the coordinated run is not continuing, with a stable code.
stop.title: Stop

surveys.description: Every survey in the governed order: its pinned version, state, individual simulation (in full), run fingerprint and execution contract.
surveys.title: Surveys

owned.description: True when this survey owns the version; a frozen version of another survey is pinned.
owned.title: Owned

note.default: Synthetic content, unapproved for operational use. No survey here is eligible for a live call.

mappings.description: Mappings that are not proposed yet: control_code, combination, applicability, entries.

evaluation_id.description: A control evaluation of the SAME journey to show beside the result. Its outcomes are copied as recorded, never computed again.

control_evidence.description: The named control evaluation's results, as recorded, each beside what was verified about the execution evidence it rests on.

current_status.description: The recorded status, or ASSURANCE_DRIFT when the result no longer recomputes from the evidence as it stands.
current_status.title: Current Status

journey_checks.description: Coordinated journeys: selection, governed order, no bypass, own evidence, no de-duplication.
journey_checks.title: Journey Checks

status.description: VERIFIED: the supported checks passed for the recording. INCOMPLETE: the evidence does not let every check finish. DEVIATION_DETECTED: the recording differs from what it pinned. INTEGRITY_FAILED: replay or fingerprints failed. NOT_ASSESSABLE: a contract is not supported. Technical statuses, not compliance outcomes.

surveys.description: Each survey execution: status, every check with its question and findings, every delivery with its pinned wording, every placement that was not delivered and why, branches, refusals, the ending.

applicability.description: Policy scope, missing inputs, lineage and the applicability fingerprint.
applicability.title: Applicability

controls.description: One control instance per control of the register: outcome, applicability, reasons, pinned mapping revision and every evidence observation.
controls.title: Controls

coverage.description: Always NOT_ASSERTED: controls without a mapping, with unknown applicability, and items no mapping names.

journey.description: The journey as evaluated: its status, whether every survey completed, whether its evidence was trusted, and each survey execution.

policy.description: The control policy revision this evaluation was made under, if any.

processing_status.description: How the EVALUATION ended — not whether surveys completed and not whether controls are satisfied. COMPLETED does not mean compliant.

status.description: The processing status, or EVALUATION_DRIFT when the evaluation no longer recomputes from what it pinned.
status.title: Status

superseded_by_current_governance.description: What is published now that this evaluation did not use. Evaluating again gives a NEW evaluation; this one is not rewritten.
superseded_by_current_governance.title: Superseded By Current Governance

records.description: Each: kind, id, label, version, sha256, sha256_of, source, facts.

dimensions.description: Five separate statements: completion, satisfaction, coverage, assurance, eligibility. None is derived from another; eligibility is always NOT_ESTABLISHED.

evidence_gaps.description: The shown evaluation's own control results whose evidence is missing, contradictory or undecided. Recorded results, filtered; nothing is computed here.

open_points.description: What is unverified or undecided for this journey, stated once.

trace_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the kind, id and fingerprint of every record in the chain, in order.

note.default: Synthetic content, unapproved for operational use. No survey here is eligible for a live call.

effective_from.description: Recorded only. Nothing takes effect on a date: scheduled publication has no behaviour.

facts.description: A synthetic fact snapshot: governed catalog fields only.

expected_inputs.description: How many inputs the simulation holds as the caller last saw it.

drift.description: What differs when the recomputed run is not the recorded one.
drift.title: Drift

engine_contract.description: The execution contract the simulation was recorded under.
engine_contract.title: Engine Contract

run.description: The complete deterministic run: delivered items, decisions, routes, modules.
run.title: Run

status.description: PENDING: a question needs an answer. Approve or reject a proposed binding. Never by its proposer.

Withdraw an open proposal (its proposer) or a published binding (a person who may publish).

For one synthetic application: decide every requirement group with the existing rules, verify each selected
version's manifest, compute each survey's own SS-03B plan, and record the composite. Nothing is assigned.

get.description: A recorded composite plan, as recorded; with whether computing it again now would give the same.

post.description:
Start a coordinated simulation of a recorded composite plan, in its governed order. Refused — with the stable
code of what is unresolved — unless the selection and the order are settled, every individual plan can be
computed and no survey version is required twice.

get.description: The coordinated simulation as it stands, computed now from its steps and the replay of each survey's own run.

post.description:
Give one typed input to the current question of the current survey. That survey's own simulation decides
whether it is accepted. The next survey starts only if this one thereby reaches COMPLETED.

For one synthetic application: decide with the existing assignment rules which published survey version is
selected, verify its manifest, assemble its call plan, and record all of it as a simulation record. A selection
assigns nothing to any customer case.

get.description: A recorded selection with its decision trace, its plan and the simulations started from it.

post.description: Start a server simulation of the selected version with the same facts, linked to the selection.

get.description: Every version of every requirement group in the caller's markets, with its members and state.

post.description:
Propose a new version of a requirement group: PRIMARY, ADD_REQUIRED or ALTERNATIVE, with its stated purpose,
its optional governed position, and the exact published rule versions that compete to satisfy it.
Approve or reject a proposed group version. Never by its proposer.

Publish an approved group version. Never by its proposer or approver. Refused when it would give the market a
second primary group or put a rule in two groups.
Withdraw an open proposal (its proposer) or a published group (a person who may publish).

get.description: The governed assignment inputs and their values: the fields of the existing assignment rules.
The published assignment rules in precedence order, each with the survey version bound to it, and every binding.

post.description:
Approve or reject. Never by a maker of the candidate, whatever they are permitted (``SELF_REVIEW_DENIED``). The
manifest is re-verified first (``MANIFEST_MISMATCH``).

get.description:
FI-2 — what a reviewer inspects: the frozen content and every pinned document with its hash and integrity, the
makers, the recorded acknowledgements, the server's validation of exactly this content, and what the identity rules
allow the reader. Read-only: a candidate is never changed.

post.description:
Publish an approved candidate as an immutable version. Never by a maker (``SELF_PUBLISH_DENIED``) nor, until
governance rules otherwise, by its approver (``APPROVER_PUBLISH_DENIED``). Publishing makes nothing eligible for a
live call.
Withdraw an open candidate. Only its submitter.

get.description:
LIB-1 — the reusable library: versions of one kind that a PUBLISHED survey version pins, in the reader's markets.
A draft, a rejected or a never-published candidate's assets are not here, whoever asks.

LIB-1 — one published component, complete: its document, every published document it depends on, its published
revisions, where it is used and what it was derived from. A component that is not published in the reader's
markets does not exist for them.

post.description:
Evaluate one condition against supplied facts and answers: TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN with the explanation.
Read-only: nothing is stored, and missing information is UNKNOWN, never FALSE.

get.description: Surveys in the caller's markets, with the status derived from their history.

post.description: Create a survey and its empty draft.

get.description: One read for the workspace's first screen. Counts and lists only; it decides nothing and changes nothing.

post.description:
Submit the draft: freeze what it pins, build the manifest, insert an immutable candidate. The draft stays
editable. A draft with any blocker is refused with ``VALIDATION_BLOCKED``.

LIB-1 — new permanent, globally unique asset codes for this survey, issued by the server. With the library on,
a new module, question, condition or option set can only be saved under a code issued here.

get.description: The draft content document, its revision and the asset versions this survey owns.

FI-1 — everything needed to open the draft in an editor: the content document, the full document of every asset
version the survey owns or pins, the server's hash and state of each, and the governed catalogs.

post.description:
Apply ONE operation to the draft: ``PUT_ASSET``, ``REMOVE_ASSET``, ``SET_CONTENT`` or ``SET_DETAILS``.
``expected_revision`` must be the draft's current revision; a stale one is refused with ``STALE_DRAFT`` and
nothing is changed.

FI-1 — one SAVE, atomically: every operation, in order, as ONE revision, or none of them. ``expected_revision``
must be the draft's current revision (``STALE_DRAFT`` otherwise, nothing changed). If any operation is refused the
whole save is rolled back and the error names the operation. The response is the complete saved draft with the
server's hashes: a client reports success only from it.
Server validation of the draft: stable codes, never matched by message. Nothing is stored.

get.description: FI-2 — every candidate and every published version of a survey, oldest first, with derived status.

post.description:
Which obligations of a policy a synthetic application requires — for a recorded revision, or for a policy that
is not proposed yet. Nothing is recorded. Unknown stays unknown.

Withdraw an open proposal (its proposer) or a published revision (a person who may publish).
